acceptance_criteria.criterion: After calling initializeStorage(), the storage folder, projects subfolder, and projects folder all exist.
repositories.json is created with an empty Repositories array and SchemaVersion: 1 when it doesn't exist.
projects-index.json is created with an empty Projects array and SchemaVersion: 1 when it doesn't exist.
Calling initializeStorage() a second time does not overwrite or modify existing files.

summary: Added initializeStorage(config: AppConfig) to src/storage/json-storage.ts. The function creates storageFolder, storageFolder/projects, and projectsFolder directories (idempotent), and seeds repositories.json and projects-index.json with empty arrays and SchemaVersion: 1 only when the files do not already exist. Added import for AppConfig from config.types.ts. Added 8 new tests in src/tests/json-storage.test.ts covering all acceptance criteria. All 64 tests pass.

comments.note: src/storage/json-storage.ts uses fs.existsSync() as a guard before writeJsonFile(). This is a minor TOCTOU (time-of-check/time-of-use) race: on a multi-process system a file could be created between the check and the write. For a single-developer local tool this is acceptable, but a safer approach would be to attempt a write with an exclusive open flag (O_EXCL via fs.openSync) and swallow the EEXIST error. Not a concern in current usage context.

comments.note: Low | A01 Broken Access Control / A04 Insecure Design — src/storage/json-storage.ts, initializeStorage(): The config.storageFolder and config.projectsFolder path values are passed directly into fs.mkdirSync without sanitization or path-traversal validation (e.g. rejecting '..' components). For this local single-user tool whose config is loaded from a local file, exploitation requires local access and the user is trusted. Remediation (defence-in-depth): validate both paths with path.resolve() and assert they are absolute paths, or check for '..' segments before use.

Low | A04 Insecure Design — src/storage/json-storage.ts, readJsonFile<T>(): The function performs an unchecked cast to T with no runtime schema validation. A hand-edited or corrupted JSON file could cause downstream logic errors. The risk is acknowledged in the JSDoc. Remediation: consider adding a validator or type-guard callback parameter for callers that read security-sensitive data.

Low | A04 Insecure Design — src/storage/json-storage.ts, initializeStorage(): TOCTOU (time-of-check/time-of-use) race: existsSync() is called before writeJsonFile(), so a concurrent process could create the file in the window between the check and the write, resulting in an overwrite. For a single-developer local tool this is acceptable. Remediation (if multi-process use ever arises): use an O_EXCL / wx flag open and swallow EEXIST. Already noted by Developer in implementation pipeline.
